description: An option chain from Cboe's delayed data for a stock, ETF or index (AAPL, SPY, SPX, VIX): bids, asks, implied volatility, greeks, open interest and volume by strike for one expiration, every expiration with its open interest, put/call ratios, max pain and the move the at-the-money straddle prices in.

expiration.description: An expiration date (2026-11-20), or "nearest" (default); the result lists every expiration.

min_open_interest.description: Only contracts with at least this open interest; default 0.

symbol.description: A stock or ETF (AAPL, SPY, QQQ) or an index (SPX, NDX, RUT, VIX, XSP).

window.description: Strikes within this fraction of the underlying price; default 0.1 (10 percent).

name: options_chain

outputSchema.description: rows are contracts for the expiration in the order of columns (IV as a fraction a year); summary has put/call ratios, max pain and the expected move.

title: Options chain (Cboe)
